text: Been waiting nearly an hour for a callback so writing instead. Grandson, 8, staying with me tonight. He's running a fever, forehead's hot, but his hands and feet are freezing cold and he's shaking and shivering under two blankets. Neck's fine, I checked, he can put his chin right down on his chest no bother. How much paracetamol or ibuprofen can I give a boy his age? His mother's not answering and I don't want to guess.
